component.name: Alexandria
component.summary: Your personal library, on your own machine

description.p: Alexandria indexes, organizes, and surfaces a single person's on-disk media and documents. It browses the catalog, plays audio and video, reads documents and comics, edits Markdown and text in place, and organizes everything into collections, watchlists, and reading lists.
There is no server, no cloud, and no synchronization: the whole product runs as a single local application, and nothing it records leaves the machine.
